title: Graph-component view spec, format 2 (APS 21)
description: One graph component with its data inline: what an assistant emits to draw a picture in an answer ({component, data, options}). Checked against the component's contract (src/validate.ts) before anything renders; a spec that fails draws nothing and its errors go back to whoever wrote it.

format.description: Optional: the view-spec format major (format 1 binds a ZQL result: view-spec.v1.schema.json).

version.description: Optional: the component version the spec was written for. Its major must equal the component's.

data.description: The data, as the contract's `data` schema says.

options.description: Display options, as the contract's `options` say. Omitted ones take their defaults.
